description: The line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) as a function of TFLOPs for different configurations of SepLLM. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs," is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at each power of ten. The y-axis, labeled "Loss Ratio (%)," ranges from 94% to 100%, with tick labels at every 1% interval. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different configuration: Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=128), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The Vanilla line is a solid purple line that remains constant at 100% across the x-axis.
